verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions JSON mode, `response_format`, JSON-schema-constrained decoding or grammar-based output for DeepInfra. The general claims of OpenAI SDK drop-in compatibility belong to a different story and do not show that schema enforcement is supported. Structured output is a fair axis for an LLM inference API, so the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I can enforce structured outputs against a JSON schema (or grammar) so model responses parse reliably
